item.title: Surface water from highway entering my property/cellar, 10th September
item.description:
Surface water from highway entering my property/cellar During rainfall, surface water from the public highway appears to be flowing towards my property and entering my cellar which is under the road. I believe the problem may have been caused or exacerbated by a recent road patch/repair, which appears to have altered the surface-water flow. I have already contacted Severn Trent Water. They have investigated and do not believe the water is coming from their water/sewer network. Please could Gloucestershire Highways inspect the road surface, the recent patch repair and highway drainage/gullies, and establish the route that the surface water is taking towards my property? This is causing water ingress into the cellar during rainfall and I am concerned that the highway drainage arrangement or road surface is directing water onto/into my property.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 10, Grosvenor Street, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Signage blocking path, 9th September
item.description:
This signage is completely blocking the path of a very narrow footpath on a very busy road. While i appreciate it’s important to inform drivers, why would this be left in such an inappropriate place? Being almost next to a retirement home and a stones throw from a primary school, there are many elderly and young children struggling to get through and we’re all having to walk onto the road to get past. A wheelchair user or someone with a buggy will struggle given the lack of dropped kerb. Why would someone from the council deem this as acceptable? A few feet up the road is a wider patch with grass where this could comfortably fit. Please move and have more respect for locals who need access to the path. (Just to note, I’ve wanted to move this for days, but don’t feel it’s my place to be able to do this?!)

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Tatchley Lane, Lynworth, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
